description:
## Goal

Replace the scan/sort `activation_frontier` side table with exact edge-triggered demand through the fact-to-producer map.

## Evidence

Every listed or relisted `Activation` can be inserted into `activation_frontier`, including already-run but not-yet-settled analyses. At each drain the driver clones the full `HashSet`, renders structural type text, sorts it, checks `has_run`, and removes spent keys. On 00420 the frontier reached 66 entries, and 918 applied completions occurred while it was nonempty. The exact authoritative trigger already exists: the absent-to-present `FactChange` for `Activation(key)`.

## Strategy and proof

1. When a completion makes `Activation(key)` appear, demand `ActivationAnalyzed(key)` through `demand_fact_producer`.
2. Preserve re-evaluation through the analysis job's standing `Current(Activation)` read; retraction and reappearance must not require rediscovery.
3. Pin multi-activation emission order, blocked analysis, macro roots, retraction/reappearance, no-op reproduction, causal work counts, and byte-identical artifacts.
4. Delete `World.activation_frontier`, note/retire/access APIs, drain scans, display-string ordering, `ActivationFrontier` telemetry, comments, and temporary probes.
5. If eager edges require buffering, use an insertion-ordered pending-edge queue consumed once; do not restore a global set scan.

This follows the standing-root deletion and the common edge-triggered wait protocol.
title: Ignite activation analysis from exact activation-appearance edges
